summary: BlindPay is building payment infrastructure for stablecoin on/off-ramps, targeting fintechs and marketplaces that need to move money across borders without traditional banking rails. The team has relevant fintech/crypto experience (ex-Coinbase, Stripe, Circle), and the product addresses a real pain point: slow, expensive, and opaque cross-border settlement. However, the $59/100 score reflects three gaps: (1) limited defensibility beyond first-mover integration depth — competitors like Bridge, BVNK, and traditional rails (Wise, Tazapay) are well-capitalized; (2) traction is early with <10 live enterprise customers and <$5M annualized volume; (3) regulatory uncertainty around stablecoin transmission licenses in key corridors (US, EU, LatAm) creates execution risk. Market timing is strong — stablecoin supply >$160B and growing — but the window to become the default infrastructure layer is narrowing. Verdict: watch. Revisit when volume and regulatory clarity materialize.
rationale: Score breakdown: Team 14/20 (strong founders, thin go-to-market bench); Defensibility 10/20 (API moat is shallow, switching costs low until volume locks in); Product 13/20 (clean developer experience, but feature parity with Bridge); Market & Why-Now 14/20 (massive tailwind, but crowded); Traction/Freshness 8/20 (pre-scale, no public case studies, freshness penalty for 2023 launch with limited public momentum). Total 59/100. The watch verdict reflects a credible team in a hot market that has not yet proven it can win the infrastructure land grab or navigate licensing at scale.
changeMyMind: Signs 3+ enterprise customers processing >$50M annualized volume each with >12-month contracts
Secures money transmitter licenses (or equivalent) in US, EU, and at least two LatAm corridors
Hires a VP Sales/BD with proven fintech infrastructure closing track record (ex-Stripe, Adyen, Bridge)
